blocks.content: The Commission shall have all the powers of a civil court while conducting an inquiry under the Central Vigilance Commission Act, 2003.

rows: Non-statutory body (derives power from DSPE Act, 1946)
Functions under superintendence of CVC for PCA cases

items: Set up originally in 1964 based on the recommendations of the Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption.
Members are appointed by the President on the recommendation of a 3-member committee: Prime Minister (Head), Minister of Home Affairs, and Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha.
The Central Vigilance Commissioner and Vigilance Commissioners are NOT eligible for further employment under the Central or a State Government after tenure.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Supervises the functioning of the Delhi Special Police Establishment (CBI) regarding offences under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
Exercises superintendence over vigilance administration of various Central Government ministries, departments, and central corporations.
Inquires into complaints against Group A officers of the Central Government and specified categories of public servants.
Reviews the progress of applications pending with competent authorities for sanction of prosecution under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
